_comment: Corpus v3, 2026-08-29. Total is 3.8B, not the 4.5B first drafted: the web rebuild dropped data/pretrain_full.jsonl, whose provenance data/PROVENANCE.md records as unknown, taking web from 8.11B to 3.55B raw. Dropping data of unknown origin is a gain, not a shortfall, and the smaller total matches the goal of training on fewer tokens. See docs/data_recipe_v3.md for the measurement behind every number here. Three changes from v2: web drops from 88% because the 82% of it that hand-reading found unusable is filtered out rather than repeated; textbook (opencsg chinese-cosmopedia) and wiki are new domains; the total falls 11.5B -> 3.8B, which FineWeb-Edu's result licenses -- filtering to their threshold reaches the same MMLU with 10x fewer tokens, and this is a 3x cut. Weights are set so that no domain repeats more than about once -- v2 ran the small domains 4-6 times over, which is not more data, it is the same data again.
_synthetic_cap: textbook is model-generated. It could supply the whole corpus (4.69B tokens available from 8 of 62 parquets) and deliberately does not: SmolLM2 uses Cosmopedia at ~11% against real web, and we have no instrument that could see the damage from overdosing it -- every multiple-choice benchmark we own sits at the 25% chance line. Real human text stays the plurality.
_domain_names: The domain key is the DIRECTORY under data/corpus. It is web_hq, not web: train.py globs data/corpus/<domain>/*.jsonl, so naming it web would tokenize the UNFILTERED 2.99M-document corpus, train perfectly well, and silently discard every filter applied to it. The unfiltered data/corpus/web stays on disk so a different threshold can be re-cut without rebuilding.
_epoch_caps: The epoch cap is shared across the main phase AND the anneal, so a main weight large enough to exhaust a pool leaves the anneal with nothing -- the failure v2's comment warned about. web is the binding one here: at 0.40 of the 3.42B main phase it wants 1.37B against a 1.42B filtered pool, leaving 0.05B where the anneal needs 0.076B. epochs 2 lifts the cap; the actual repeat is about 1.05x. Verify with scripts/check_mix.py --mix data/mix_v3.json once web_hq exists -- it prints exactly which domain/phase got capped.
